{{Quote|It's an X-TIE Ugly, Luke! And the only shipyards that can put those together&mdash;''"<br />"''&mdash;are in Corellia.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="AAS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>}}
The '''X-TIE Fighter''' was an [[Ugly/Legends|Ugly]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] made out of the cannibalized parts of a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] and a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]. The ship consisted of an X-wing fuselage and engines, and solar panels from a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] Fighter. The solar panels replaced the [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] that were present on a standard X-wing.

==Characteristics==
[[File:X-TIE2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X]]-[[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|Fighter]].]]
Weaponry usually consisted of two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] mounted on the fuselage, where the proton torpedo launchers were located on the X-wing, though some mounted the X-wing's lasers on the fuselage and others retained one warhead launcher at the price of carrying only a single laser. A far superior variant was the [[X-ceptor]], which used [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptor]] solar panels and thus had an armament comparable to that of a standard X-wing. Like many other uglies, this ship was barely spaceworthy, and used predominantly by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and other cash-poor groups. Though capable of harassing unarmed commercial vessels, these ships could be destroyed en masse by a single true starfighter.

==History==
The [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Forces]] were known to employ Uglies, including X-TIEs, during the disorganized period after the fall of the Empire. [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Belindi Kalenda]] used one to escape the Corellian system and warn the New Republic moments before the [[Corellian Crisis]].

==Behind the scenes==
The non-canon ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy]]'' features ships called [[TIE-wing]]s which resemble X-TIEs,<ref name="SWKidsYouTube-LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy Part Four &#124; Full Episode">{{SWKidsYouTube|ThAGOmfly0I|LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy Part Four &#124; Full Episode}}</ref><ref>{{LEGOWeb|url=en-us/product/tie-fighter-x-wing-mash-up-75393|text=LEGO® ''Star Wars''™ TIE Fighter & X-Wing Mash-Up}}</ref> although in that continuity TIE-wings seem to be a standard design rather than Uglies.
